# Gloves of Thievery (`magic-items:gloves-of-thievery`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** No

Wondrous Item

These gloves are imperceptible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.
